title: Dampproofing required.
officialText: Where hydrostatic pressure will not occur as determined by Section 1802, floors and walls for other than wood foundation systems shall be dampproofed in accordance with this section. Wood foundation systems shall be constructed in accordance with AF&PA TR7.
